info.aboutSubtitle: Stratega — a trusted supplier of electric stackers and hydraulic pallet trucks
info.aboutBody: Stratega is the most convenient platform for buying electric stackers and hydraulic pallet trucks in Uzbekistan. We provide quality lifting equipment for warehouses, manufacturing plants, and retail chains, with a warranty, VAT documentation, and fast delivery.
info.principle1: Transparency — prices and product information are shown fully and accurately.
info.principle2: Speed — orders are processed and delivered quickly.
info.principle3: Convenience — search, filters, and comparison tools make shopping easier.
info.principle4: Support — our operators are always available for your questions.
info.legalNote: Contracts and invoices for legal entities are arranged through our operator — please reach out when ordering or via the phone number above.
info.deliverySubtitle: How and when your order will arrive
info.howItWorksStep1: You confirm your order — our operator will contact you.
info.howItWorksStep2: The product is packed and handed over to the courier service.
info.howItWorksStep3: The courier delivers it to your address, and you receive the product.
info.howItWorksStep4: You pay by cash or card.
info.warrantyBody: All products are sold with a manufacturer's warranty. Depending on the product type, the warranty period ranges from 6 to 24 months and is shown on the product page. If a defect is found during the warranty period, the product is repaired or replaced free of charge.
info.faqSubtitle: Can't find an answer? Contact us via the Contacts section
info.faq1Q: How do I place a request?
info.faq1A: Select the products you need, click "Add to cart", then from the cart click "Get a quote" and enter your company name, contact person, and phone number. Our manager will contact you within 30 minutes.
info.faq2Q: How do I check my request status?
info.faq2A: After you submit a request, our manager will call you with exact pricing and delivery terms.
info.faq3A: The payment method is agreed individually for each deal — cash, bank transfer, or up to 30 days of payment terms for regular customers.
info.faq4A: Yes, under warranty terms. See the "Return policy" section for details.
info.faq5A: 1-2 days within Tashkent, 2-5 days to the regions. The exact time may vary depending on the product and region.
info.faq6Q: Are documents (invoices) provided for legal entities?
info.faq6A: Yes, all required documents (invoice, contract) are provided for legal entities. Just let the operator know when placing your order.
info.faq7Q: Is there a quality warranty on products?
info.faq7A: All products are sold with a manufacturer's warranty. The warranty period is shown on the product page.
info.paymentSubtitle: Choose the method that suits you
info.cashDesc: You pay the courier in cash upon receiving the product.
info.paymeDesc: Online payment via the Payme app.
info.clickDesc: Online payment via the Click app.
info.cardDesc: Payment via the courier's POS terminal on delivery.
info.paymentFooter: Currently orders are accepted with cash payment. Online payment systems will launch soon.
info.returnsSubtitle: If a product doesn't suit you, you can return it under the following conditions
info.condition1Prefix: The product can be returned within
info.condition2: The product must be in its original packaging, unused, and undamaged.
info.condition3: A receipt or order number is required.
info.condition4: For defective or faulty products, there is no return time limit — it will be replaced according to warranty terms.
info.nonReturnableBody: For hygiene reasons, underwear, cosmetics, and personal hygiene items, as well as software products with broken packaging, are non-returnable (unless they are defective).
info.processStep1: Call our operator or provide your order number.
info.processStep2: State the reason for the return — our specialist will guide you further.
info.processStep3: Hand over the product in its original condition to a courier or bring it to the store.
info.processStep4: Your payment will be refunded within 3–5 business days.
